column1: # The lens shading tables the X3F tools library (commit e8b48ca, BSD 3-Clause, built from source) selects for the
# CC0 samples, through x3f_get_spatial_gain with the white balance of x3f_get_wb: per table the sample, the first
# channel, the channel count, the grid rows and columns, the element count, the smallest, largest and summed
# element and nine elements at even steps through the table.
